chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey Ch. 420: The Artisan's Patience – Guide
chapter_meta_description: Han Li ends his twenty-year mortal life to begin refining his ultimate treasures. A deep dive into the quiet victory phase of the Mortal Stream.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey – Ch. 420 Guide: The Artisan's Patience
og_description: After two decades as a shopkeeper, Han Li returns to his cave to forge his Green Bamboo Flying Cloud Swords. A masterclass in cultivation patience.
twitter_description: The quiet before the storm. Han Li refines treasures and masters formations in a twenty-year-long preparation arc.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator's internal fire, used for refining magical artifacts and materials. It is an expression of one's cultivation base and mana, requiring immense control and stamina.

A talisman that can replicate the power of a mid-grade spell. Far rarer and more difficult to produce than low-grade ones, they are treasures for any Foundation Establishment or Qi Condensation cultivator.
A rare, sacred wood that naturally generates arcane lightning. When matured to a high age, it becomes a supreme material for forging Lightning-attributed magical treasures.

The non-physical perception of a cultivator, capable of detecting energy, life force, and hidden threats. A stronger spiritual sense is a prerequisite for controlling multiple objects and higher-tier spells.
